rationale: The primary retrospective series records post-motor-onset visual hallucination history in 14 of 31 GBA carriers, excluding events attributed to medication and resolved after a medication change, or febrile illness and delirium. It assesses presence and onset lag without comparable noncarrier clinical symptom data, episode frequencies or dried-fig exposure.

The clinical review separates infestation belief, skin sensations and additional visual symptoms. Parkinson and Huntington links are cited, alongside a multiple system atrophy case. No original dried-fig comparison or Parkinson visual frequency estimate. FIG denotes illustrations.
